announcement.quote: IMPORTANT NOTICE TO SHAREHOLDERS OF NUVEEN MORTGAGE OPPORTUNITY TERM FUND (JLS) AND NUVEEN MORTGAGE OPPORTUNITY TERM FUND 2 (JMT)

outcome_evidence.quote: the filing was prepared in connection with a proposed issuance of the Fund’s shares as part of a proposed merger transaction that is no longer contemplated;

deals.notes: The acquiring fund (the registrant, CIK 1769901) was newly formed; its N-8F states it never commenced operations or issued shares, so it was not exchange-listed. No excerpt states that JLS is exchange-listed (only the ticker in parentheses is printed). Outcome is withdrawn (RW of the N-14, 2019-05-24); the N-8F of 2019-10-23 is an abandonment of registration, board approved termination of the fund May 21-23, 2019. both_listed false rests only on the acquirer never having issued shares.

problems: Outcome is withdrawn per the RW, but both_listed is false because the acquirer was an unissued shell; a reader applying the not_a_listed_pair rule strictly would code outcome not_a_listed_pair instead.
